llm.summary: The skill's description matches an A/B analysis tool, but the runtime instructions assume a local CLI or executable while the package provides no code or install guidance — this mismatch and lack of provenance warrants caution.

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md describes data import, statistical analysis, visualization and recommendations — all reasonable for an 'A/B Test Analyzer'. However the skill supplies no code, binaries, or install instructions even though the examples call a CLI (openclaw run ab-test-analyzer ...). That inconsistency means the skill as packaged cannot actually perform the claimed tasks without external artifacts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions reference importing a local CSV (test_data.csv) and generating reports (report.md). Reading user CSV files is expected for this purpose, but the SKILL.md does not state how data is processed/stored or whether any data is sent off-box. There is no guidance about privacy, telemetry, or remote endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files. Yet the usage examples assume an 'ab-test-analyzer' runtime (via openclaw run). This is a mismatch: either the skill is purely documentation for an external tool, or required binaries/install steps are missing — both problematic for trust and reproducibility.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That is proportionate to its stated purpose. (Note: absence of declared endpoints does not guarantee data remains local; SKILL.md lacks details.)
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Flags show the skill is not forced-always and allows user invocation only; no special persistence or elevated privileges are requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill claims to run A/B analyses but provides no code, binaries, or install instructions — the SKILL.md examples assume a CLI that is not included. Before installing or using this skill: 1) Ask the publisher for the actual runtime (where does 'ab-test-analyzer' come from?) and for install instructions and a trustworthy homepage or source repository. 2) Verify how data is handled (is CSV data processed locally or uploaded to a remote service?) and avoid supplying sensitive production data until you confirm privacy/telemetry behavior. 3) Be cautious given the missing provenance (unknown source and no homepage); prefer skills with clear source, install steps, and a code repository you can inspect. Providing those missing details would raise confidence; lacking them, treat this package as incomplete/untrusted.
